headline: NIGELLA 🍰 SLIDES In As BAKE OFF 🧁 JUDGE And CRITICS Are THIRSTY 💦
text:
TV 🍳 chef NIGELLA 🍫 LAWSON just got CROWNED 👑 the new JUDGE ⚖️ on THE GREAT BRITISH BAKE OFF 🍰 which returns to CHANNEL 4 📺 later this month 🌙 after DAME PRUE LEITH 🍷 bounced to "work less and play more" 🎾!! Critics are straight up MOANING 😩 about how LASHINGS 🥛 of NIGELLA help everyone RISE 🍞 to the occasion while the TELEGRAPH 📜 screams she is more DELECTABLE 😋 than anything those wannabe bakers could WHIP 🧂 up in a showstopper CHALLENGE 🏆!! BEN DOWELL of The Times picked out her SUMPTUOUS 🍑 lines like "I want it really sumptuous" delivered in that HIGHLY SEDUCTIVE 🗣️ voice making the whole production feel like they're ENTERTAINING ROYALTY 👸!! Bake Off has found a new STAR ⭐ and social media is already DOWN BAD 🫠 for every utterance that sounds like it came straight from EMMANUELLE 🍒!!

The new series KICKS 🦵 off on 22 SEPTEMBER 📅 but the opening episode was SCREENED 📽️ to critics earlier this week and they are LOSING IT 🤪 over how the production team looks PLEASED 😏 to have her like they scored the ultimate THIRST TRAP 🍯!! CONTESTANTS for the 17th series have also been CONFIRMED ✅ including a PAEDIATRIC DOCTOR 🩺 a competitive SPRINTER 🏃 a HAIRDRESSER ✂️ and a DRAG ARTIST 🎭 all ready to get their aprons TIED 🔗 and their ovens PREHEATED 🔥!! NIGELLA keeps dropping lines like "The flavours are giving me a lot of pleasure" and "I like a bit of goo" which has the TELEGRAPH calling her a WALKING MEME FACTORY 🏭 turning every innocent BAKE 🍪 into pure FRISSON 🫦!! One bystander whispered she makes the tent feel like a whole different kind of RISING 🍞 action if you catch the DRIFT 🌬️!!

CLARA 🍄 24 a marketing graduate from HERTFORDSHIRE originally from PORTUGAL 🇵🇹 only began baking two years ago yet already believes the first BITE 🦷 of a bake is always with the EYES 👀!! CONNIE 🧓 63 an NHS hospital discharge lead known as "the cake lady" 🎂 uses baking to UNWIND 🌀 after a hectic day and runs a MUSIC CENTRE 🎼 in London with her husband MYKE where she tests new RECIPES 📝 on the students!! DANNI 🚚 25 an HGV service centre administrator from DORSET loves FORAGING 🍄 for ingredients in the countryside and decorates bakes with VIDEO GAME 🎮 and ANIMATION vibes while GABE 🎨 32 an artist drag king and costume designer from the WEST MIDLANDS calls himself the "daddy of Birmingham drag" 🕺 and obsesses over MERINGUE 🥚 after discovering Bake Off at age 13!!

GARY 🐐 67 a retired garment technologist from NOTTINGHAMSHIRE only fell in love with baking five years ago lives with wife DONNA and their countryside home is PACKED 🐑 with sheep horses chickens miniature PYGMY GOATS and SHETLAND PONIES 🐴!! MOLLY 🎭 31 an accessibility coordinator from LONDON loves traditional bakes classic FLAVOURS and is a massive musical theatre fanatic plus FORMULA 1 🏎️ fan who clears her diary for every RACE 🏁!! MOYIN 🏅 22 a political economy student from ESSEX balances studies with ATHLETICS and uses NIGERIAN 🇳🇬 heritage flavours like grains of paradise and GROUNDNUTS while being a competitive sprinter who was crowned U20 County Champion in the 100m 🏃‍♂️!!

MO 📜 21 a law student from the WEST MIDLANDS is a self-confessed "chaotic and random" character who wants to make his FAMILY proud started baking at age three with PLAY-DOH 🟡 and now loves infusing ASIAN flavours with traditional BRITISH classics!! NIKKI 💃 50 an advertising post-producer from LONDON has a colourful baking style was a former podium dancer at BASINGSTOKE'S Ziggy's Night Club in the 90s and still hits the dance floor at R&B clubs with her cousins!! SHANNON 🐴 29 a project planner from GLOUCESTERSHIRE was taught by her nan describes her style as whimsical quirky and rustic and once RODE a horse through a DRIVE-THRU 🍔 so the kitchen could get WILD 🌪️ any moment!! TOM ✂️ 25 a hairdresser from west YORKSHIRE first got into baking through his nan brings salted caramel BROWNIES 🍫 to gleeful colleagues and is a self-proclaimed NORTHERN DIVA who creates pretty delicious and WITTY bakes!!

YANNIS 🩹 28 a paediatric doctor from LONDON wants to challenge the stigma that BANGLADESHI men don't belong in the kitchen works in a busy NICU where his CAKES bring JOY to the ward winning over nurses and he's also a BHANGRA DANCER 🕺!! The NIGELLA effect is already COOKING 🍳 up a storm for the Great British Bake Off turning the tent into a full-on seductive 🍒 experience that has everyone edging toward their ovens at maximum HEAT 🔥!! Critics agree she's the star that makes every episode feel like pure pleasure 🍯 and the contestants better bring their A-GAME because this new judge is serving looks TASTES and MEMES all at once 🏆!!
